title: GEBCO: General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans
description: Cloud-optimized copies of the GEBCO global grids (15 arc-second elevation of ocean and land, EPSG:4326), with virtual multidimensional indexes over them (GDAL VRT, Kerchunk, Icechunk, STAC). Each annual release is its own dataset. The indexes read the COGs in place; no data is copied. GEBCO grids are in the public domain; attribution to the GEBCO Compilation Group is requested. Not for navigation.
